issue_context.title: Xiaomi Miio set_preset_mode doesn't have all the correct preset modes for Air Purifier 3H
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Air putifier 3h have just three preset_modes available with the integration Xiaomi Miio. Should be four.
Available:
preset_modes:
  - Auto
  - Silent
  - Favorite

Should be:
preset_modes:
  - Auto
  - Silent
  - Favorite
  - Fan

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.3.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Xiaomi Miio

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/xiaomi_miio

### Example YAML snippet

service: fan.set_preset_mode
data:
    preset_mode: Fan
target:
  entity_id: fan.mi_air_purifier_3h

Hey there @rytilahti, @syssi, @starkillerog, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`xiaomi_miio`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L540) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

You have to use service `fan.set_speed` like it says in the docs.

So the problem is that `fan.set_speed` is marked as deprecated, and that this integration should change to `fan.set_preset_mode`. But if I understand the comments in #47262 correct, the code owners are about the rewrite this integration, and I guess they remove deprecated services then.
Thank you. In fact I wanted to replace the deprecated fan.set_speed service with the new fan.set_preset_mode. I will wait for the integration to be updated. thank you.

review_comments:
If we just add preset mode support and keep set speed support, the old set speed service should still work for users to set presets. Ie it will not be a breaking change.

Please check this.
I've removed the feature flag to disable the slider at the frontend.
Do you agree with the breaking change? I will update the description of the PR in this case.
These actually look like speeds.  These should be implemented as percentages in the new model.
It was implemented as speed in the past to get the device support merged. The operation mode "auto" is missing here. I would like to stick to presets.

Or should I implement both:

```
set_speed ['low', 'medium', 'high']
set_preset_mode ['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high']
```

To be Alexa and Google Home compatible?

Preset mode should remain as auto, manual (or none, currently called favorite) and silent. 

Fan speed in percentage is possible in manual (or none) preset using favorite levels or motor speed.

Edit: Fixed my brainfart. This is the correct thread. Maybe the title can be changed to "adapt Xiaomi miio air purifier fan speeds and presets".
